primitives.note: Barrel Roll is thrown, sits for up to 4s fermenting for up to 2s (ramping damage/slow to 150%), then is either manually recast or auto-detonates; initial cast and detonation are separately timed events with different on-cast trigger rules.
After the 0.75s channel, Gragas' next basic attack within 5s is empowered with bonus magic damage based on target's max HP and AP, plus range/uncancellable windup.
Body Slam deals damage on dash-collision (fixed short delay); Explosive Cask deals damage on impact after a 0.25s cast + 0.5s travel; both simply go on cooldown afterward.
Body Slam's current cooldown is reduced by 40% if it hits an enemy, which it will against the stationary dummy.
Mana costs (80/30/50/100) on cooldowns as low as 5-12s can meaningfully cap cast frequency over a 15s fight depending on assumed mana pool/regen.

needsBespoke.why: Barrel Roll's damage and slow scale continuously with how long the cask has sat (0% to 150% of base over the first 2 of its 4s duration) before the player chooses to recast/detonate it. None of the closed primitives capture a continuous, player-timed value ramp inside a recast window (recast-or-multipart only says a recast exists, not that its payload is a tunable function of elapsed time); the simulator needs bespoke logic to pick and apply a fermentation time before computing detonation damage.

unsettled.question: How long should Gragas wait after Barrel Roll lands before recasting/detonating it, in the 15s damage fight?
options: Detonate immediately on landing (minimum travel+cast delay, lowest per-cast damage but highest cast frequency)
Always wait the full 2s to fermentation cap for 150% damage/slow before detonating
Some intermediate hold time optimized for total 15s DPS
quotes: Upon arrival, the cask starts to ferment over the first 2 seconds of its duration to increase its {{ccs|damage|magic}} and the effectiveness of its {{tip|slow}}, up to a maximum of 150% of their initial values.
''Barrel Roll'' can be recast at any time within its duration after the cask has fully travelled, and does so automatically after its duration ends.

proposal: Open with Explosive Cask (R) on the dummy immediately, since it has by far the longest cooldown and should be used as early and as often as its cooldown allows.
Immediately follow with Barrel Roll (Q), throwing the cask onto the dummy so its fermentation timer starts running while other cooldowns are used.
Cast Drunken Rage (W) next to start its 0.75s channel; once it completes, land the empowered next basic attack on the dummy for its bonus max-HP/AP magic damage.
Cast Body Slam (E) into the dummy for its damage and the 40% cooldown refund it grants on hit, then continue auto-attacking between ability casts.

Recast/detonate Barrel Roll once it has fermented for the chosen hold time (see unsettled fermentation-timing question) rather than letting it auto-detonate late, so its cooldown (which started on the initial cast) is used efficiently.
Recast Drunken Rage every time its 5s post-effect cooldown is up, always following up with a basic attack to consume the empowerment.
Recast Body Slam every time it is off cooldown (12-14s base, refunded 40% on every hit against the dummy).
Recast Barrel Roll on cooldown (10-6s depending on rank) using the same hold-then-detonate pattern each time.
Recast Explosive Cask again only if its long cooldown (100-70s) comes up within the 15s window at very high CDR; otherwise it is a once-per-fight opener.
Fill all remaining time with basic attacks.
questions: Is Gragas assumed to start the fight already in melee/ability range of the dummy at t=0, or does travel time to close distance need to be modeled (it changes when the empowered W attack and Q's travel/ferment clock actually land)?
Should Barrel Roll always be held to full 150% fermentation before recasting, or does an expert consider faster low-value recasts better DPS over a 15s window?
At the assumed level/items for the damage fight, is mana sufficient to sustain the full Q/W/E/R rotation for 15s, or must some casts (likely W spam, given its 5s cooldown vs 30 mana cost) be skipped?

Does Explosive Cask's 0.25s cast time block Body Slam or Barrel Roll from being queued during it (since Body Slam explicitly says Q and R can be cast during the E dash, but nothing is said about casting other spells during R's own cast time)?
